pages.text: The Ranker researched ways to capture enemy abilities and bind them to equipment. His sword, $(bold)Tears for Fears$(), trapped a Warden's call. People across the Brass Concord helped his experiments; he promised help in return. Twelve were still waiting when he died pursuing the Hovering Inferno's power.

Restore those twelve homes, hear the witnesses and retrace the work behind his strength. Your Create and GTCEu Stone/Steam, LV, MV, HV, EV and IV journey continues alongside these stories. Team dimension encounters still govern travel. The research and lost-ring entries explain the lore; they introduce no additional crafting requirements.
